augments.name: Guild Membership Card
augments.desc: Members get a better cut: 12% more scrap.

events.text: A guild auction house is selling salvage rights to a wrecked battleship. The bidding is fierce and the auctioneer talks very fast.

effect.text: You win. The wreck yields a weapon, missiles and spare parts.

success.text: Everyone else bids on the wrong lot. You win for a song.

fail.text: Outbid. The guild keeps your deposit as a 'handling fee'.

effect.text: You learn a lot about prices.

events.text: A guild recruiter in a very sharp suit floats beside your airlock. "Join the Merchant Guild. Better prices, better friends, better insurance."

effect.text: Welcome to the Guild. Here is your card.
Fully covered, as long as you read the small print. You do not.
"Your loss." The recruiter leaves a brochure anyway.

events.text: A nervous trader asks you to carry a sealed crate through the next sector. "No questions. Good pay."

effect.text: You stow the crate. It ticks occasionally.
"I said no questions." They find another courier.

events.text: Your contact is waiting at the rendezvous. The crate has stopped ticking, which is either very good or very bad.

success.text: "Perfect." They pay double for the speed.

fail.text: "This is the wrong crate." It was not, but they are not paying.

effect.text: It is full of spare drone parts and a very old sandwich.

events.text: A guild bank station offers to look after your scrap. "Deposit now, withdraw with interest a few jumps later."

effect.text: Your receipt is printed on very official paper.
Your scrap stays under your mattress.

events.text: A guild courier catches up with you, holding a sealed envelope. "Your deposit, with interest."
